title: Tom Emmer issues endorsements for congressional candidates LiPetri and Gober
text:
Tom Emmer U.S. House of Representatives from Minnesota's 6th district | https://convention.acec.org/
Tom Emmer U.S. House of Representatives from Minnesota's 6th district | https://convention.acec.org/
Tom Emmer, U.S. Congressman representing Minnesota’s 6th district since 2015, recently issued a series of endorsements and political statements on his social media account.
On February 3, 2026, Emmer publicly supported Mike LiPetri in the New York 3rd Congressional District race. In his post, he stated: "@TheMikeLiPetri is exactly the type of fighter we need to take this seat back and deliver common sense results for New Yorkers. Mike has my full endorsement, and I look forward to sending Tom Suozzi back into lobbying. #NY03"
The following day, February 4, Emmer endorsed Chris Gober for Congress in Texas’ 10th District. He wrote: "I am proud to endorse @ChrisKGober for Congress in TX-10. Chris has spent his career winning some of the toughest legal battles of our time to stop the weaponization of government by Democrats, protect the integrity of our elections, and safeguard our constitutional freedoms. I"
Later that same day, Emmer commented on federal policy regarding transgender healthcare for minors under President Donald Trump’s administration: "The Trump Administration is not playing around when it comes to protecting our kids.
It is SICK that puberty blockers were given to children in the first place.
Thank goodness we have President @realdonaldtrump to put an end to this nonsense!"
Emmer has served as a member of Congress since replacing Michele Bachmann in 2015 and previously held office in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2005 to 2011. Born in South Bend, Indiana in 1961 and currently residing in Delano at age 62, Emmer holds a BA from the University of Alaska-Fairbanks (1984) and a JD from William Mitchell College of Law (1988).
